operations.title: Research state for BSSC private-message sum-capacity
operations.summary: For the stated binary-input broadcast channel, the exact private-message sum-capacity remains open, with governed benchmark 0.361642884421954615663441578150587… ≤ C_sum ≤ 0.369296945969202842443. The accepted fixed-pair converse does not establish matching achievability or global auxiliary-receiver or dual-face optimality. A separate accepted program now records finite-block dependence-balance structure and the capabilities and limitations of a specified coarse entropy relaxation; its value 2h₂(1/4)−5/4 is neither a lower nor an upper capacity bound and does not change the numerical frontier.

operations.title: Finite-block dependence balance and limits of coarse entropy relaxation
operations.summary: Program for exact finite-block and selected-coordinate constraints from reliable private-message broadcast codes and for analysis of what a specified coarse BSSC entropy relaxation can and cannot prove. Accepted results include a finite-block dependence-balance telescope, fixed-map selected-coordinate constraints, a sharp fair-input posterior support, a finite entropic counterfeit, and a scoped universal-inequality and finite-copy no-go. No fixed-alphabet compactness theorem or improvement to the BSSC capacity interval is established.

operations.title: Exact finite-block private-message dependence-balance telescope
operations.summary: For deterministic finite-block private-message codes, the accepted exact telescope equates the sum of coordinatewise conditional-dependence differences to I(A;B|Yⁿ)−I(A;B|Zⁿ). Fano bounds imply a normalized defect bounded by max{δ₁,δ₂}, which vanishes along reliable bounded-rate code sequences. This is a sequence-level condition because the induced auxiliary alphabets may grow with blocklength; no compact fixed-alphabet single-letter region follows.

operations.title: Selected-coordinate fixed-map factorization and rate constraints
operations.summary: Every deterministic private-message code induces the accepted selected-coordinate factorization with the stronger fixed-map property X=f_T(U,V), independent of the realized state W. Two individual-rate and two sum-rate inequalities are accepted with Fano defects. No simultaneous cardinality or compactness reduction for U,V,W,T is established, so arbitrary small-alphabet optimization would not certify a universal capacity converse.

operations.title: Sharp fair-input BSSC posterior-difference support
operations.summary: With h=h₂(1/4), r=h−3/4, and g(q)=I_Z(q)−I_Y(q), the accepted global affine support is g(q)≤2r(1−q) on [0,1], with tangent contact at q=1/5. For fair input it yields I(X;Z|A)−I(X;Y|A)≤r and the reflected inequality. The constant is sharp for the stated posterior mixture. The result is limited to this fair-input scalar direction and is not a capacity theorem.

operations.title: Finite entropic counterfeit for the specified coarse BSSC relaxation
operations.summary: An actual finite joint distribution satisfies the specified coarse BSSC entropy relaxation and attains B₁=B₂=2h₂(1/4)−5/4=0.3725562489182657…. Its component accounting, base entropy vector, disjoint-subtuple BEC identities, and tight scalar support rows are accepted and corroborated by a formal-entropy checker. This value is only an objective of the deliberately over-relaxed formulation: it is neither a lower nor an upper BSSC capacity bound and does not change or contradict the governed capacity frontier.

operations.title: Universal-information-inequality and finite-copy no-go for the coarse relaxation
operations.summary: Because the accepted counterfeit is an actual finite joint distribution, universally valid finite-variable information inequalities cannot exclude it, and standard copy-lemma extensions can be realized by conditional resampling. Thus neither such inequalities nor any finite sequence of standard copy-lemma extensions can force the specified coarse relaxation below 2h₂(1/4)−5/4. This obstruction is limited to the specified relaxation and methods and does not determine BSSC sum-capacity or rule out other converse techniques.
